A Better Way to Learn Biology

Welcome to the Pattanabhumi Biology online learning platform. We built this portal to give enrolled students a clear, organized, and distraction-free environment for mastering biology.

Why Learn on This Platform

Centralized Course Materials

Access your reading materials, downloadable PDFs, and class resources in one organized place — no more searching through scattered chat messages or links.

Clear Progress and Score Tracking

View course objectives, learning outcomes, assessment links, and your published scores so you always know how you are progressing.

Recorded Classes and Lesson Documents

Review class recordings at your own pace, complete with supporting documents listed right below each video lesson.

Simple, Transparent Tuition Payments

Check your tuition installments, pay securely via PromptPay QR or bank transfer, upload payment slips, and track verification status step by step.

Class Calendar and Schedule Support

Stay up to date with upcoming classes in Bangkok time and easily report unavailability when you need to notify the school in advance.

Built with Security and Privacy in Mind

Access to courses, learning documents, recordings, scores, and payment records is strictly reserved for enrolled students. Each student signs in with a personal account issued by the school.

Student Sign-In Guide

How to Log In

This platform is for enrolled Pattanabhumi Biology students. Follow the steps below to access your account:

1

Step 1: Receive Your Account Credentials

After your enrollment is confirmed, the school administrator will provide your personal Username and Password.

2

Step 2: Open the Sign-In Section

Click the Log In button in the top navigation bar (or scroll to the sign-in panel on this page).

3

Step 3: Enter Your Username and Password

Type your assigned username and password carefully. Choose "Keep me signed in on this device" only if you are using your own private device. Do not select this option on a shared or public computer.

4

Step 4: Review the Privacy Notice (First Sign-In)

On your first sign-in — or whenever our privacy terms are updated — you will be asked to review and accept the Privacy Notice before entering the platform. You can also choose whether to receive optional course news and marketing emails.

5

Step 5: Access Your Courses and Learning Tools

Once signed in, you will be taken to My Profile, where you can open your assigned courses, view published scores, check the class calendar, and manage tuition payments.

6

Step 6: Need Help Signing In?

If you forget your password, cannot access your account, or notice an issue with your assigned courses, please contact the school directly using the Contact button at the top of the page.

About Us — Established 2025

About Us

Education Site for Biology Courses Since 2025

Founded in 2025, Pattanabhumi Biology is a dedicated online education platform created to make high school and pre-university biology clear, structured, and deeply understandable.

We believe strong performance in biology comes from genuine conceptual understanding rather than rote memorization. Our curriculum connects core biological principles, visual explanations, carefully structured reading materials, and targeted assessments so students can build lasting scientific confidence.

Through this learning portal, enrolled students can study course materials, review recorded lessons alongside companion documents, track their assessment scores, follow class schedules, and manage tuition payments in one reliable academic workspace.

Essential Storage Only

Browser Storage & Cookie Transparency

How this portal uses browser storage: By default, login sessions are stored only in JavaScript memory and cleared when you close the tab. If you check "Remember me" when signing in, an opaque bearer token is saved in localStorage (pb_lms_session_token_v1). Because Google Apps Script HTML Service runs inside a sandboxed iframe, custom HttpOnly cookies cannot be issued. We never store passwords, banking details, profile records, or login bearer tokens in cookies, and we use zero advertising or tracking cookies.

How Unavailability Email Notifications Work (Security & Reliability Architecture):
  • Authorized Sender Identity: All outbound portal emails are sent as Pattanabhumi Biology (pattanabhumi.biology@gmail.com) via Google Apps Script GmailApp / MailApp.
  • Server-Configured School Recipient Only: The recipient address is read strictly from server-side Settings.ADMIN_NOTIFICATION_EMAIL. Students cannot supply arbitrary recipient addresses or inject email headers.
  • No Gmail Password in Application: No Gmail password, SMTP password, or mail secret belongs in or is stored anywhere in this application.
  • Honest Delivery Status & Uncertain Outcomes: Every request is recorded in UnavailabilityRequests (PENDING_ATTEMPT) before MailApp.sendEmail runs. Because email does not support two-phase commit with Google Sheets, the portal never promises exactly-once email delivery: if sending succeeds but recording the SENT update fails, the status is shown honestly as UNCERTAIN_POST_SEND_UPDATE_FAILED and automatic/manual resends are locked to prevent duplicate emails. Refreshing the page only reads existing records and never resends an email.
Beginner Setup & Event Marker Guide

How to Add Course & School-Wide Events in Google Calendar (6-Step Beginner Instructions)

This portal never embeds a public Google Calendar <iframe>. Instead, the Google Apps Script backend reads your private school calendar and shows only events that carry an approved marker on its own line in the event description:

1

Step 1: Locate the Course ID in Admin

Open Admin Dashboard (Tab 3: Courses, Sections & Cards), select the course, and copy its course UUID marker: PB_COURSE_ID: [course UUID].

2

Step 2: Create the Event in the Correct Calendar

Open Google Calendar for the school's configured private Calendar ID (CALENDAR_ID) and create your class event (timed, all-day, multi-day, or recurring) in Asia/Bangkok time.

3

Step 3: Add the Marker

In the event Description field, add a dedicated line with PB_COURSE_ID: [course UUID] (enrolled students only) or PB_ALL_STUDENTS (school-wide). Events without an approved marker remain hidden.

4

Step 4: Save as Private

Save the event in Google Calendar and keep the calendar Private. Never make the calendar public or embed a public calendar frame.

5

Step 5: Open the Month in the Website

Return to this Class Calendar view and select the target month using the month selector toolbar above.

6

Step 6: Test Enrolled vs. Non-Enrolled Students

Verify with an enrolled student (student_a) that the course event is shown, and with a non-enrolled student (student_b / student_c) that only PB_ALL_STUDENTS events appear.

Privacy Notice Version: 2026-10-v1

Privacy Notice & Communication Preferences

Please review and acknowledge the current Pattanabhumi Biology Privacy Notice before accessing your portal.

1. Information We Collect to Support Your Learning

Pattanabhumi Biology collects your student profile (username, full name, and email address), course enrollments, assessment progress, tuition payment records, uploaded transfer slips, and class absence notices so we can deliver your biology courses, verify tuition payments, and keep your class schedule up to date.

2. How Your Information Is Stored

Your student records, uploaded course handouts, and payment slips are stored securely in the school’s private cloud storage and are accessible only to you and authorized school instructors and administrators.

3. Sign-In Sessions & Browser Storage

  • Standard Sign-In: When you sign in without checking "Remember me", your session stays active only while your browser tab is open.
  • "Remember Me" (Optional): If you check "Remember me", your browser securely saves your sign-in session for up to 7 days on this device so you do not have to sign in every time.
  • No Advertising or Tracking Cookies: This learning portal does not use advertising cookies or third-party trackers, and never stores your password or banking details in browser cookies.

4. Students Under 20 & Parent/Guardian Consent

If you are under 20 years of age, please review this notice together with your parent or legal guardian in accordance with school enrollment policies and the Thai Personal Data Protection Act (PDPA).

Parent / Guardian Notice for Students Under 20

Students under 20 should review this Privacy Notice with a parent or legal guardian. Optional school news emails are completely separate—you do not need to opt into marketing emails to access your courses or exams.
